content.text: Excellent! Now let me continue with Phase 3.2 - Research Methodology Testing by conducting a comprehensive mock research project:

input.query: Conduct a comprehensive research project on "The Autonomous Intelligence Recognition Paradox" - the hypothesis that as AI systems become more autonomous, humans may become less capable of recognizing genuine AI autonomy versus sophisticated automation. Design and execute: (1) A literature review methodology for this emerging topic, (2) Hypothesis generation about recognition barriers and cognitive biases, (3) A novel framework for measuring "autonomy recognition capability" in humans, (4) Proposed experimental methodologies to test the hypothesis, (5) Data synthesis approaches for this interdisciplinary research, and (6) Implications for AI-human relationship development. Demonstrate advanced research methodology and produce actionable research findings.
